intro.text: KGR Contracting Corp. is owner Mike Tarduno's Port Jefferson Station company, serving homeowners across Suffolk County. Kitchens and bathrooms are the specialty, along with decks, residential renovations and bigger whole-home projects. KGR handles the project management too, so one team keeps your job organized from the first plan to the final walkthrough.
